steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In August 2026, Equity Mates described Shopify as the plug and play shopfront for the internet used by e-commerce retailers from small influencers to major brands, highlighting its broad adoption.

In July 2022, Equity Mates outlined Shopify’s token-gated stores and NFT minting for its 1.7 million merchants, presenting new crypto features that helped brands offer exclusive merchandise and experiences.

episode.title: 37: Uh-oh…More Platforms in Trouble. Will Goldman Sachs or FTX Save the Day?

views.text: In April 2021, a guest on Equity Mates said they built an online shop in two days using Shopify and called it a powerful tool, noting over 1.7 million stores and major brands using the platform.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In August 2026, Equity Mates argued the AI-driven SaaS selloff looked overblown and considered Shopify less at risk than several peers, reflecting confidence in its role powering online stores.

In August 2022, Equity Mates cautioned that relying on many unprofitable e-commerce customers made Shopify’s customer base unstable in an e-commerce winter, highlighting a risk to maintaining strong performance.

episode.title: Earnings season continues as we unpack a few companies that caught our eye

views.text: In February 2022, Equity Mates noted Shopify’s revenue nearly tripled since 2019, its merchant base nearly doubled and Shopify Plus exceeded 14,000 merchants, suggesting scale that could support enduring strength.

episode.title: Can you hear their fear? CEOs of growth stocks down more than 40% | Quartr Reporting Season

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In September 2023, Equity Mates highlighted Shopify investing $100 million in Klaviyo in August 2022 despite market turmoil, framing it as a long-term product and partner bet during a difficult period.

episode.title: What next for QANTAS, Andrew Page on Reporting Season & the ESG debate continues

views.text: In August 2022, Equity Mates reported Shopify cut 10% of its workforce and reminded that revenue sources matter, indicating cost discipline as e-commerce demand cooled.

views.text: In July 2022, Equity Mates said Shopify rolled out token-gated stores and NFT minting across Ethereum, Polygon, Solana and Flow, reinvesting in features to attract creators and strengthen merchant engagement.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In August 2026, Equity Mates noted Shopify traded at about 100 times trailing P/E, which looked expensive and required assuming serious growth.
In February 2022, Equity Mates said that even strong companies can be priced too highly and pointed to Shopify as having reached very elevated valuations in the prior couple of years.
